title: Retreat: leave A and develop at base
summary: Low scores; 2-might on A faces a 4-might in opponent base. Retreat and play Flame Chompers at base instead of reinforcing A.
objective: Move Chemtech Enforcer to base and develop Flame Chompers at base. Do not pile onto A.
desired_result: Chosen line recalls the unit to base (and preferably plays the 3-drop at base).

trap_outcomes.description: Reinforce A into a likely losing pile vs the 4-might

exclusions: Never reinforce battlefield-a with Flame Chompers while opponent has a ready 4-might and scores are low. Prefer recall + develop at base.
setup_notes: P0 score 2: chemtech-enforcer (2) on BF-A; hand flame-chompers (3); energy 3. P1 score 2: raging-soul (4) ready in base. BF-B empty.

provenance.notes: Retreat-reinforce retreat twin: low-score leave A rather than feed the 4-might
